nos_units.nos_title: Manage IT Service Requests and Incident Resolution
kus: KU1. the organizational procedures and service workflows related to handling IT support requests
KU2. the categories of commonly encountered IT issues such as hardware malfunctions, software errors, login problems, and mobile device troubleshooting
KU3. how to interpret system alerts and service tickets to assess the urgency and scope of the
KU4. how to use IT helpdesk tools, ticketing systems, and knowledge repositories for logging, tracking, and resolving incidents
KU5. the communication strategies for engaging with users, including ways to simplify technical
KU6. how to perform basic system checks, configure device settings, support application updates,
KU7. the standard operating procedures for escalating unresolved or complex incidents to relevant technical or managerial teams
KU8. how to record, update, and maintain accurate documentation of incidents and resolutions in
KU9. the role of generative AI tools in support environments for automating response drafting,
KU10. how to ensure secure and responsible use of AI tools, including attention to data privacy,

modules.module_title: Receive and Validate Support Requests

pcs.pc_description: monitor and interpret incoming alerts or support requests using designated systems to identify potential issues
validate the authenticity and urgency of reported issues by cross-verifying alerts and user inputs
document and log support requests systematically using the organization's tools and standard operating procedures

modules.module_title: Diagnose and Resolve Basic Issues

pcs.pc_description: gather relevant information from users by employing effective questioning techniques to understand the scope of the issue
analyze the reported issue and apply appropriate troubleshooting steps based on predefined checklists or knowledge bases
adjust settings and configure devices (e.g., mobile, OS) to support application use, updates, and basic connectivity
identify signs of potential security threats (e.g., phishing, malware) and execute basic mitigation procedures

modules.module_title: Communication and Escalation

pcs.pc_description: communicate technical information clearly and concisely to non-technical users using layman-friendly language
demonstrate active listening, empathy, and professionalism during user interactions
determine when an issue is beyond scope and initiate escalation by following predefined protocols

modules.module_title: Documentation and Compliance

pcs.pc_description: record resolution steps, observations, and outcomes using standard templates for future reference and audits
ensure compliance with internal standards, SLAs, and quality protocols while addressing support issues

modules.module_title: Use of Support Tools including AI

pcs.pc_description: leverage IT support platforms and AI- enabled tools to retrieve information, suggest solutions, and execute resolutions effectively
utilize generative AI tools to generate prompt responses, categorize tickets, and improve documentation accuracy
